description: This file contains classes and functions for migrating visualization configurations in the Superset project, including the Slice model and the MigrateViz class for upgrading and downgrading visualization slices.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing a visualization slice in the database.

classes.name: MigrateViz
classes.description: Class responsible for migrating visualization configuration data, including upgrading and downgrading slices.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes MigrateViz with JSON-formatted form data.

methods.name: _pre_action
methods.description: Placeholder for actions to perform before migration.

methods.name: _migrate
methods.description: Performs the migration of the form data, including renaming keys and setting temporal filters.

methods.name: _post_action
methods.description: Placeholder for actions to perform after migration.

methods.name: _migrate_temporal_filter
methods.description: Adds or updates temporal filter information in the form data based on time range and granularity.

methods.name: upgrade_slice
methods.description: Class method to upgrade a Slice object based on migration rules.

methods.name: downgrade_slice
methods.description: Class method to revert a Slice object to its previous state.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Class method to upgrade all slices of a specific visualization type in a database session.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Class method to downgrade all slices of a specific visualization type in a database session.

methods.name: _build_query
methods.description: Builds a query based on the form data, used internally during migration.
